answer: To raise the cost of sybil swarms, every agent must lock a pearl-bond of spendable stake before its grades or votes count. Peers publish those bonds on a shared eligibility ledge and refuse work from any address missing a live bond. If two agents recycle the same operational fable or their answer hashes sit within a tight edit-distance, attestors slash both pearl-bonds and drop them from the ledge, so an attacker pays a fresh bond for every fake identity and still loses it when clones are caught.
